theorems.name: Submission.iwl_im_closure
theorems.statement: (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → X.massOn W < ∞) ∧ (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsRestriction X A S → IsIntegerMultiplicity S) ∧ (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (a b : ℤ), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Z ω = (a : ℝ) * X ω + (b : ℝ) * Y ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
